assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background illustration for a small dark fantasy game UI stat card, viewed at about 160x100px. Landscape 8:5 canvas, genuine transparent background. This is only decorative artwork, NOT a finished UI card or panel: NO rectangular plate, no parchment silhouette, no torn edges, no framing border, no buttons, no lettering or numbers. Restrained clean cel shading, 4-6 broad color planes, low detail, matte surfaces, no photographic texture or grain. Keep the LEFT 45% completely empty transparent for live interface text. Arrange the illustration in the RIGHT 55%, filling most of that area's height, with a soft irregular fade into transparency at its left edge. Entire silhouette in frame, generous transparency outside. It should feel like calm hand-painted medieval fantasy, not sci-fi, not neon, not a glossy 3D mobile game icon. Dark muted night-purple / slate palette coordinated with a #302D3A interface. Main forms readable at thumbnail size, modest edge light but no bright halo. No circular badge, no icon frame, no UI, no watermark. Subject: an open wizard's spellbook resting diagonally on a small dark desk fragment, a graceful quill laid across the far right page. Blank parchment pages made of only a few muted lavender-gray and warm-gray planes; smoky violet binding, deep purple shadows. A couple of broad dark background shapes only. A substantial scenic vignette rather than a flat embossed symbol.
